"""Additional post-launch, pre-quality nominal mesh period stratification."""
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V167-bounded-support-v1'
prep_path=repo/'docs/results/v167-mesh-period-strata-preparation-v1.json';prep=read(prep_path)
assert ref(Path(__file__))=={k:prep['source'][k] for k in ['path','sha256']}
assert ref(root/'quality-design-v1.json')==prep['design']
cases={c['id']:c for c in read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations']}
scores=read(root/'scores-v1.json');groups=defaultdict(list)
fields=['full_error_RMS_DN16','template_gain','blank_error_RMS_DN16','blank_spatial_RMS_DN16','blank_DC_RMS_DN16','blank_added_RMS_DN16']
for row in scores['rows']:
 if row['kind']!='mesh':continue
 c=cases[row['id']];recipe=c['source']['recipe'];fine=sum(v<=10 for v in recipe['periods_final_pixels'])
 groups[row['method'],row['present'],fine].append((row,recipe['seed']))
records=[]
for (method,present,fine),values in groups.items():
 seeds=defaultdict(list)
 for row,seed in values:seeds[seed].append(row)
 per_seed=[{'seed':seed,'rows':len(rows),**{field:float(np.mean([r[field] for r in rows])) for field in fields}} for seed,rows in seeds.items()]
 assert all(v['rows']==4 for v in per_seed)
 records.append({'method':method,'present':present,'nominal_carriers_at_most10_pixels':fine,'rows':len(values),'distinct_recipes':len(seeds),
  'means':{field:float(np.mean([r[field] for r,s in values])) for field in fields},'per_seed':per_seed})
assert len(records)==36
output=repo/'docs/results/v167-mesh-period-strata-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'completed-additional-nominal-period-stratification','preparation':ref(prep_path),'scores':ref(root/'scores-v1.json'),
 'groups':records,'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
 'scope':prep['scope']})
for r in records:
 if r['present']:print(r['method'],'fine families',r['nominal_carriers_at_most10_pixels'],'recipes',r['distinct_recipes'],'response',r['means']['template_gain'],'full',r['means']['full_error_RMS_DN16'],'blank',r['means']['blank_error_RMS_DN16'])

scope: Additional post-launch diagnostic frozen while original full review was live and before V167 scores or completed review existed. Three fixed groups have zero,one or two nominal carrier periods <=10 native pixels. Threshold rounds the qualitative reference dominant7.12-9.40 pixel interval upward;this is not a measured post-geometry spectral period. All64 recipes/all related CFA and noise rows retained;means and per-recipe means reported for all six fixed methods,present and empty cases. Related variants are not independent scenes;no significance,promotion gate,causal claim or new neural/sensor calls. Existing main protocol and all frozen scientific/publication helpers unchanged.
